meta.source: OpenQR repository: branding/build_icons.py, app/src/main/res (v0, 1.0.60) and the ui-1.1 Compose screens

tokens.name: brand-field
tokens.usage: Field behind the mark in brand files (branding/manifest.json `field`).

tokens.name: brand-tile-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the graphite app-icon tile gradient (build_icons.py TILE).

tokens.name: brand-tile-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the graphite tile gradient; also the dark-ink mark colour on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The mark's bracket ink on graphite; the dim bracket is this at mark-dim opacity.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Top-left stop of the mark's lit core. The one brand hue: CodeTag brackets on real codes, the scanning ring, hover/focus rings. 8:1 on surface.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Bottom-right stop of the mark's lit core; the PillReader's scan track.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panel and pill body (colors.xml `surface`). Every text token below is checked on it.

tokens.name: preview-frame
tokens.usage: Icon wells: the ScanToggle disc and the icon on each notice (`preview_frame`).

tokens.name: preview-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim over the camera preview inside the viewfinder (`preview_scrim_background`). v0 scanner window only; the MR design uses brand-sky for tags.

tokens.name: status-background
tokens.usage: Status badge fill (`status_background`).

tokens.name: outer-border
tokens.usage: v0's 1px panel edge (`outer_border`). Don't draw it in new work: Horizon OS draws the panel edge itself.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, pill status line and icons on surface, preview-frame and status-background (9.4:1 on surface).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting lines under a state title, on surface.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Hints and the grey (not scanning) dot, on surface (5.1:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: colorPrimary/colorAccent; pulse ring and lock/scan state icons.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted well behind accent content.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Success check icon and the scan-line core.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Soft white glow (#24FFFFFF) on the scanner edge.

tokens.name: icon-badge
tokens.usage: Icon badge fill (`icon_badge`).

tokens.name: button-fill
tokens.usage: Primary ActionButton at rest; its label is action-button-text.

tokens.name: button-fill-hovered
tokens.usage: Primary ActionButton on ray hover or focus.

tokens.name: button-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary ActionButton while pressed.

tokens.name: button-fill-disabled
tokens.usage: Any ActionButton when disabled.

tokens.name: scan-button-fill-active
tokens.usage: ActionButton and camera button while active (scanning / preview on); white label on it (6:1).

tokens.name: scan-button-fill-active-hovered
tokens.usage: Active button on hover or focus.

tokens.name: scan-button-fill-active-pressed
tokens.usage: Active button while pressed.

tokens.name: secondary-button-fill
tokens.usage: Quiet ActionButton fill; label text-primary.

tokens.name: secondary-button-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Quiet ActionButton pressed or selected.

tokens.name: secondary-button-fill-disabled
tokens.usage: Quiet ActionButton disabled.

tokens.name: secondary-button-stroke
tokens.usage: Quiet ActionButton 1px edge (#406F86A3).

tokens.name: secondary-button-stroke-selected
tokens.usage: Quiet ActionButton edge when selected (#609AB5D4).

tokens.name: button-stroke-rest
tokens.usage: 1px edge of a white button at rest (#16FFFFFF).

tokens.name: button-stroke-hovered
tokens.usage: 1px edge of any button on hover or focus (#88B8CCE8).

tokens.name: button-stroke-pressed
tokens.usage: 1px edge of any button while pressed or active (#8098B6D9).

tokens.name: button-text
tokens.usage: Dark label on a white fill (`button_text`).

tokens.name: action-button-text
tokens.usage: Primary ActionButton label at rest, on button-fill (6.7:1).

tokens.name: action-button-text-hovered
tokens.usage: Primary ActionButton label on hover/focus.

tokens.name: action-button-text-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary ActionButton label while pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on scan-button-fill-active and other filled accents.

tokens.name: scan-frame
tokens.usage: Viewfinder brackets and scan line while scanning (#A02E8FFF). v0 scanner window only; the MR design uses brand-sky for tags.

tokens.name: scan-bracket
tokens.usage: Small scanner-glyph brackets and sweep (#994A90E2) v0 scanner window only; the MR design uses brand-sky for tags.

tokens.name: status-panel
tokens.usage: Floating status panel fill (#E623262C).

tokens.name: status-panel-stroke
tokens.usage: Status panel 1px edge (#66566678).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: ADDED, not in the repo: stands in for UI Set `positive.content`, the green scanning dot and success icon. Replace with the UI Set value. 7.3:1 on surface; always paired with words or an icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: ADDED, not in the repo: stands in for UI Set `warning.content` (warning icon in a status). Replace with the UI Set value.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: ADDED, not in the repo: stands in for UI Set `negative.content` (error icon in a status). Replace with the UI Set value.

styles.name: app-title
styles.usage: v0 panel title, centred in a 48dp row (sans-serif-medium, 22sp).

styles.name: status
styles.usage: v0 status line, text-secondary. Below the 14sp Horizon OS floor: keep for v0 only, use body in new work.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: ActionButton and CodeChip labels (14sp medium, textAllCaps off).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: UI Set display: the largest heading, one per screen at most.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: UI Set headline: state title and the "Scanned" heading.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: UI Set title: dialog or component titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: UI Set body: supporting lines, the pill's status title, button labels. 14sp is OpenQR's legibility floor.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UI Set label. Below OpenQR's 14sp floor: don't use in the headset UI.

styles.name: bodySmall
styles.usage: UI Set bodySmall. Below the 14sp floor: don't use in the headset UI.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: UI Set caption. Below the 14sp floor: don't use in the headset UI.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Title-to-body gap; spacing inside chips.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: v0 scanner shell side inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Compact window padding; heading-to-list gap; status row gap in the pill.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: v0 gap between title, viewfinder and action row.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between action-row controls; scanner shell top/bottom inset.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: v0 panel padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section spacing in the 1.1 screen (doubled between columns).

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: ActionButton side padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: 1.1 screen padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: UI Set threeXLarge: the largest layout step.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Scan line ends.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: v0 viewfinder well, preview scrim, status badge.

tokens.name: radius-20
tokens.usage: v0 panel container.

tokens.name: radius-26
tokens.usage: Floating status panel.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: UI Set control (checkbox, switch track).

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: UI Set card, menu item and tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: UI Set menu and text field.

tokens.name: radius-22
tokens.usage: UI Set button: half of the 44dp button height, so buttons read as capsules.

tokens.name: radius-24
tokens.usage: UI Set dialog.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button and the PillReader: capsules and discs (999dp in the drawables).

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum interactive target (Horizon OS): ScanToggle, notices, chips, ActionButton height.

tokens.name: pill-width
tokens.usage: Widest the pill grows (it hugs its content); also the compact panel's declared width.

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: Pill height.

tokens.name: pill-min-height
tokens.usage: Compact window minimum height.

tokens.name: primary-button-max
tokens.usage: Widest an expanded ActionButton grows.

tokens.name: button-min-width
tokens.usage: Narrowest ActionButton.

tokens.name: scan-toggle
tokens.usage: The pill's lead control: a disc inside the 72dp capsule.

tokens.name: scan-ring
tokens.usage: Stroke of the scanning ring around the scan toggle.

tokens.name: tag-stroke
tokens.usage: CodeTag corner brackets on a real code (at panel scale; about 4 mm at 1 m).

tokens.name: notice-width
tokens.usage: Fallback notices: the stack's width, centred above the pill.

tokens.name: notice-height
tokens.usage: Fallback notice minimum height: a 48dp icon, two 14sp lines.

tokens.name: mark-dim
tokens.usage: The mark's second (dim) bracket.

tokens.name: out-of-view
tokens.usage: A CodeTag whose code tracking was lost, for its 8 s linger.

tokens.name: ring-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/focus ring on the ScanToggle, notices and chips: 3dp, brand-sky (1.1 uses UI Set `link`). 8:1 on surface.

world.note: Placement in the room for the mixed reality mode. Design targets to verify on a headset, not SDK values.

tokens.name: world-pill-distance
tokens.usage: The pill sits about 1 m away, body-locked with lazy follow. Never head-locked.

tokens.name: world-pill-drop
tokens.usage: The pill rests about 20 degrees below eye level, out of the way of codes straight ahead.

tokens.name: world-tag-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between a code's bottom edge and its destination chip.

tokens.name: world-text-min
tokens.usage: Smallest text, as visual arc (Meta designer guidance). Chips on far codes scale up to hold it.

tokens.name: world-code-range
tokens.usage: Where MRUK reads codes reliably enough to tag (codes should be close, large and well lit).
